power_providers.label: Hypnotist Investigator Talents
power_providers.description: Choose an investigator talent at levels 5, 11, and 17; talents that only augment class abilities the Hypnotist lacks are not legal.

resources.name: Inspiration
resources.description: Pool equals half Hypnotist level + casting ability modifier. Bluff, Diplomacy, Intimidate, and Sense Motive can be augmented without spending a point.
